records.falsifier: The fresh paired canary gains less than 0.05 Span-F1, degrades any span/file coverage or precision or validity metric, exceeds the total-token cap, or violates exact provenance/feature replay.
records.mechanism: At reserved finalization, present at most eight receipt-bound pinned-base candidates as metadata and retrieval handles, ranked by runtime-visible task agreement and observation features within 1,024 measured tokens. The model may choose any delivered IDs or abstain; ARE appends nothing after response.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash fresh 8K ContextBench development tasks at the 96K cumulative input-plus-output tier.
records.statement: A compact finalization slate lets GLM choose relevant delivered evidence better than deterministic post-response closure while remaining inside the same cumulative token cap.
